facts.fact: The Minister of Home Affairs replied in Parliament that Home Affairs uses HANIS, ABIS and the National Population Register for biometric enrolment and verification of identities.
facts.system: HANIS, ABIS and National Population Register

facts.fact: The Minister of Home Affairs replied in Parliament that HANIS and ABIS biometric verification detects duplicate, fraudulent, cancelled or blocked identity records in the National Population Register.

The Minister of Home Affairs replied in Parliament that identity information submitted for voter registration and voting is verified through an electronic interface against the National Population Register, linking the Electoral Commission and Home Affairs.
The Minister of Home Affairs replied in Parliament that Home Affairs runs the National Population Register, which it uses with HANIS and ABIS to verify identities and source documents.
The Minister of Home Affairs replied in Parliament that the Electoral Commission's voter registration identity data is verified electronically against the National Population Register.
